description: The bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance (y-axis, ranging approximately from 85 to 89) of various fine-tuning methods (x-axis) when applied to two sizes of the RoBERTa model: “base” (represented by dark blue bars) and “large” (represented by brown bars), as indicated in the legend titled “RoBERTa Size.” The fine-tuning methods compared are Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, and S₅-model. For most methods, the large model consistently achieves higher GLUE scores than the base model. Notably, LoRA and S₅-model show the highest performance overall, with the large variant of S₅-model reaching the top score near 89. In contrast, BitFit and Prefix show the lowest performance, especially for the base model, which dips below 85. The S₁-model shows nearly identical performance for both base and large models, around 85.5. The bars are grouped by method, with base and large variants placed side-by-side for direct comparison. The chart visually emphasizes that model size generally correlates with higher performance across methods, though the magnitude of improvement varies.
